post.title: Fed minutes: almost all officials see more rate hikes
post.ig:
Almost all Fed officials expect more rate hikes, minutes show.
The Fed held rates at 3.75%-4% in October in a 10-2 vote; both dissenters wanted a hike.
Fed staff put September PCE inflation at 3.6%, versus a 2% goal.
A couple of officials floated a bigger-than-usual hike at the Dec 8-9 meeting if inflation runs hot.
Bankrate's average credit card rate: 19.71% (Nov 4).
Sources: Federal Reserve FOMC minutes (Nov 18, 2026), CNBC, Bankrate.
